esports_order_detail_refund_note: Refund policy: no online or self-service refunds. Digital content counts as delivered once unlocked or in effect, non-refundable by default; exceptions are handled offline by support (with reason and proof), a refund reclaims the unlock (single) or the remaining window (membership), all audited.
esports_order_detail_refund_desc: Refunds {amount} in full to the original payment method — irreversible. Unlocks and the remaining membership window are not repossessed by this action; reclaim them on the member side as needed. All audited.
esports_order_detail_refund_ph: Record the offline settlement, e.g. support ticket #123
